ops.oldText: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer.
ops.newText: Upon creation, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer, and such ownership is not conditioned on payment of Fees.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the payment condition so title to Deliverables vests in us on creation, consistent with our position that we own what we pay for and that ownership is not held hostage to a fee dispute; Vendor retains its usual payment remedies (including suspension under Section 13.3). If Vendor needs a payment link, we could accept vesting conditioned only on payment of undisputed Fees for the relevant Deliverable.
input.summary: Deliverable ownership vests on creation, not subject to payment of Fees.
